headline: The Good Ladds Drop a 191-Burger While Matt Wunder Benches a Quarterback Into Oblivion
subhead: Week 8 served a 0.76-point heart attack, a 46-point bench massacre, and Kyler Murray getting shipped out of the Stroud Boys boat like cargo.
matchOfTheWeek: Little Peckers vs. Browning Out was a 354-point shootout decided by less than a Hunter Henry target — 0.76 points, to be exact. Tucker Kraft put up 36.8 like a WR1, and Patrick still had RJ Harvey (24.1) AND Justin Fields (20.86) rotting on his bench while losing by the width of a pubic hair. That's not a loss, that's a war crime against your own roster.
powerRankingsShakeup: The Good Ladds just dropped 191 AND traded for Aaron Rodgers and Javonte while fleecing bjewett — they're the league's final boss now. Stroud Boys are in full demolition mode, and Christian McCalfinjury continues to live up to the name with the lowest score AND the worst lineup of the week.
mainRecap:
Let's start with Matt Wunder, who scored 92.24 while Jordan Love put up 28.30 on his bench. That's not a misclick, that's a personality disorder. Christian McCalfinjury left 46.78 points on the pine — you could've benched HALF your starters and still scored more. Nut Olave Your Face didn't even need to try; Mustard ran for 33.4 and Madison Beer's side piece tossed in 26.28 while you watched Jordan Love mock you from the sideline.

The Good Ladds put up ONE-NINETY-ONE. Jonathan Taylor went full 37.40 nuclear, and then Mig went and traded for Aaron Rodgers and Javonte Williams just to twist the knife. Meanwhile bjewett shipped out Kyler Murray (a.k.a. Top 27) for what we can only assume was magic beans, then lost by 8 to T swift's Baddies anyway. The Prodigal Son couldn't save you, Money Mill$ couldn't save you, nothing could.

Kyle (QAmon) deserves his own paragraph of pain. Troy Franklin drops 26.9, you still lose by 9, and you had Oronde Gadsden (21.2) and Isaiah Davis (17.9) sitting on the bench. Then — THEN — you traded for Isaiah Davis AND Burrow's broken toe in the same week. The ARbiter is arbitrating against you, my guy.

Egbukkake quietly dismantled Rub My Chubb 131-94 because Big D apparently forgot football was on. QB1.02 looked like QB1.00 with 27.28, Chase Brown chipped in 25.5, and Marvin Mims is now a Chubb so… congrats? OnlyFants squeaked past QAmon thanks to Rashee Rice going off, and McBridesStrangeWhiteHock got Breece Hall'd 32 points and STILL lost by 44 because The Good Ladds were operating on a different planet. Brutal week. Beautiful week.

weeklyAwards.blurb: 98.4% lineup efficiency and Tucker Kraft going full alien, and you STILL only won by 0.76 — frame it, then never speak of it.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Dropped 191, then casually mugged Stroud Boys for Kyler Murray on the way out — Mig is playing chess, the league is playing checkers.
